flagged.evidence: The item’s locator says “§5.2.1, Theorem 1 and proof, PDF pp. 6–8.” The cited PDF places Theorem 1 in §5.2 on PDF p. 4; its proof starts on p. 6 and ends on p. 7. The stated range omits the theorem statement and extends beyond the proof.

The Statement defines π_t as “the deterministic greedy policy under a fixed tie order” but does not require the learner to select π_t(s_t). Proof step 1.1 relies on that unstated condition when it says that, absent an update or escape, “the true interaction and M_t have the same transition/reward kernels along these H steps.” For a counterexample, take one state, γ=0, rewards 1 and 0, K_t equal to all pairs, and Q_t=1 for both actions, with tie order choosing the reward-1 action. Let the learner always select the reward-0 action. With B=W=Q_c=1 and η=0.1, the optimism, policy-accuracy and zero-complexity hypotheses hold, but N_{4η}=∞, contradicting the conclusion.
